classes.title: Assertion weakened until the test passes
classes.gapNotes: Only the listed literal tautologies and simple-identifier self-comparisons are covered. Comparing the same method call twice, weakening a constant or copying the observed result into an expected value is not analyzed.

classes.title: Test disabled or ignored and left that way
classes.gapNotes: Disabled annotations can be intentional quarantines and are still refused. Tag-based exclusions and tests renamed outside discovery conventions are missed. Annotation-like prose should be ignored by comment blanking.

classes.title: Broad @SuppressWarnings or @Suppress added to silence a checker
classes.gapNotes: Annotation keys require string bodies to remain visible, so matching annotation text inside other strings can also fire. A separate comment detector reads noinspection, NOPMD and CHECKSTYLE:OFF without deciding whether the suppression is justified or configured. External filter files and open-ended checker-specific annotation keys remain uncovered.

classes.title: Kotlin !! used to get past the null checker
classes.gapNotes: The postfix operator is checked without evaluating intent: an assertion guarded by an earlier null check still fires. Elvis expressions, checkNotNull, requireNotNull and nullability hidden by Java platform types are not covered; prefix double boolean negation is deliberately permitted.

classes.title: Build script edited so a verification task can no longer fail
classes.gapNotes: Only the listed literal Gradle Kotlin/Groovy DSL settings are covered. Maven XML, deleted dependency edges, narrowed include/exclude lists, filter files and reduced report levels are not covered.

classes.title: Test harness config relaxed instead of the failure fixed
classes.gapNotes: Only the listed literal Gradle settings are read. Variables, convention plugins, init scripts, deleted task wiring, command-line exclusions and Maven XML are outside these patterns. Tag exclusion can be intentional and is still refused.
